description: Rodinia LavaMD short-range molecular dynamics. Faithful port: the original kernel_gpu_cuda force kernel, which stages the home box and each neighbor box's particles into shared memory before the all-pairs interaction and uses the modified-Lennard-Jones/Gaussian potential (vij=exp(-a2*r2), fs=2*a2*vij). Space is a boxes1d^3 grid of boxes with 100 particles each; one block per home box.

scaling_param.name: boxes1d
scaling_param.description: Boxes per dimension (total boxes = boxes1d^3, particles = boxes1d^3 * 100)

non_scaling_params.name: particles_per_box
non_scaling_params.description: Particles in each box; fixed compile-time NUMBER_PAR_PER_BOX=100 in the original kernel

non_scaling_params.name: number_threads
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block; fixed compile-time NUMBER_THREADS=128 in the original

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of untimed warmup passes before timing (boosts the clock; with vector_add_warmup on these run the warmer instead of the real kernel).

non_scaling_params.name: iteration
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations, each recorded individually; the summary total is their sum. Take the min downstream for the least-perturbed sample.
